sharedRules.name: Anathema Psykana
sharedRules.description:
ANATHEMA PSYKANA units carry this ability: they can join your army although they lack the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword.
Unless a rule says otherwise, while you muster your army:
- ANATHEMA PSYKANA cannot be the army faction you select.
- An ANATHEMA PSYKANA model cannot be selected as your WARLORD.

sharedRules.name: Martial Ka'tah
sharedRules.description: At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability become readied. A readied unit can use one of the ka’tah abilities below at its stated trigger. After using it, that unit is no longer readied. ### Dacatarai WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can re-roll hit rolls of 1. ### Kaptaris WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls. ### Rendax WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE]. ### Conservai WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn: - Being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action. - Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot. ### Calistus WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move. TARGET: That readied unit. EFFECT: When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model. ### Salvus WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That readied unit. EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: - BS. - Hit rolls and wound rolls.
